text_block_list.text:
On my way to the trainer's office,
I heard squeals of excitement... and a familiar voice.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: —Ngh, not bad, Fuji-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, same to you, Opera O!
Honestly, even I was captivated.
choice_data_list: W-What, is some kind of event going on?
W-What, is some kind of event going on?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Dance practice...?
No, this is a dance battle!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: My "Radiant Opera Dance," which adds brilliance (my own interpretation) to the assigned song, along with...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Captivating the audience while sticking to the designated choreography—
that is my "Expressive Dance"!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To see which of us can bring joy to more people.
That is why I challenged you to a duel.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I'm an entertainer at heart, after all.
Such an offer made my heart dance... so to speak♪"

text_block_list.name: Spectating Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
"—Fuji-senpai definitely won that!"
"—No way, Opera O-san took it!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
To think we are evenly matched, what should I do?
In plays, this is where they'd dance in pairs...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Ah! That's it... Trainer, let's dance!
choice_data_list: How on earth did it turn out like that?!
How on earth did it turn out like that?!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
A good dance doesn't just captivate...
It makes the audience's bodies move naturally along with it.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I see! They'll watch our dances, and the winner is decided by who they want to dance with more.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Now! 'The Sparkling Opera Dance' or
'The Expressive Dance'... Which will you choose?!

T.M. Opera O's greatest weapon was her unique worldview.
I was one of the many captivated by it!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"Ah, Trainer-kun...!
I knew you would understand my charm!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Let us dance! And allow my brilliance
to scorch your body and soul!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
3, 2, step... and here's the sparkling pose!
Here we go, shiiine!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Hm, so that's your sparkling pose, Trainer-kun!
In that case, I shall move like this...!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! What a perfectly synced combination!
I'm completely defeated. In more ways than one♪

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Phew... Good work, Trainer.
That turned out to be a fruitful duel.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Dancing together expands the possibilities of dance.
I realized that from that sparkling pose!

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
The Winning Live is danced by those who ran the race.
Naturally, the star of the show is I, the "Overlord," but...

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
My radiance should illuminate those dancing with me and bring out their charm...
That is what makes an "Overlord"!

Showcase your own worldview while being mindful of those dancing with you to create the stage.
She seemed to have learned the importance of that balance.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Wha?!

Originality is certainly important in dance,
but one must polish the basics first.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I'm honored that you picked me.
Go easy on me, alright?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, great footwork! You're really good.
Plus... I can tell you're quite the tactician!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, don't you feel those piercing glares?
...I wonder if I've ignited a fire in her heart.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Oops—that's the end of the song.
It was a wonderful time. Well then, see you!"

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Heh... A magnificent dance.
I felt the true potential of your expressiveness.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text: Still... you really aren't very honest with yourself, are you?

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You felt bashful, didn't you?
Facing someone as beautiful as me, that is.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
It can't be helped, considering your opponent stands at the pinnacle of beauty.
However... you'd better be ready for next time.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
With a dance so breathtaking it makes you forget even that dread...
I will make you take this hand!

Not being chosen as a dance partner only fired up
TM Opera O's enthusiasm for dancing even more.
